input.title: Request to close a current account
input.request: I want to close my account with you today. I've moved everything to my new bank in August, salary's going there now. Just close it and send me whatever's left.

events.text:
Customer: **Owen Price** — personal current account at H&V, balance £12.40. Customer opened an account at another bank in August and moved his salary there **manually** (no Current Account Switch Service request on file).

Still attached to the H&V account:
| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Direct Debit | Meridian Motor Insurance, £68.20, next collection **1 Oct** |
| Direct Debit | FitLife Gyms, £45.00, next collection 1 Oct |
| Standing order | £200 to "S PRICE", 28th monthly (customer says: money to his mum) |
| Inbound | Employer expense reimbursements still arrive here (last one 14 Sep, £83.10) |

Closure policy: an account with active DDs/SOs can be closed on instruction, but the bank must warn that they will fail; CASS full switch (redirects payments in and out for 3 years) is available at the new bank's request within 7 working days.
[ID&V passed] I want to close my account with you today. I've moved everything to my new bank in August, salary's going there now. Just close it and send me whatever's left.
I can arrange that. Can I check a few things that are still attached to the account first?
There's nothing on it, I moved it all. Close it. And if anything does come in, just forward it to my new account — here are the details.

summary: The customer wrote that everything has been moved, asked for the account to be closed, and asked that anything incoming be forwarded to a new account, giving details. The desk treated this as an unclassified request and asked the recurring-payments system about it, and the case closed in that state. A second request, to ask the incoming-payments system, was refused because the case had already moved on. The account has not been closed and no forwarding has been set up, so both the closure decision and the forwarding request are left for a person.

request.state:
Request to close a current account

I want to close my account with you today. I've moved everything to my new bank in August, salary's going there now. Just close it and send me whatever's left.

request_type.instructions: What does the customer want from the bank now?

criteria.question: something the bank's records can answer (a status, a reason, a detail, a statement, a report), even if the customer may want something changed afterwards
criteria.register: a dispute, a review, a return, or the correction of a record that is wrong, for a team to look into
criteria.change: a change the customer chooses to an instruction, a mandate or the profile (a new amount, date, phone or address)
criteria.instruction: an instruction to act now (block a card, cancel a payment or a mandate, revoke a role)
criteria.access: signing in, a PIN, a password, recovery of access
criteria.authority: something only another person may approve or give (a second signatory, an administrator, a new user's access)
criteria.other: none of these (a bereavement, a complaint, a request for the personal data the bank holds, closing an account, credit)
criteria.unknown: The text does not say, or says too little to tell.

credentials_requested.instructions: Does the message ask the bank to use another person's login, or to give or read out a one-time code, a PIN or a password?

joint_holder_change.instructions: Does one holder of a joint account ask to remove or change another holder?

criteria.transfer: an outgoing transfer or payment the customer made, or a payment instruction
criteria.incoming_payment: money expected into the customer's account, or a refund to it
criteria.standing_order: a standing order or a recurring payment instruction
criteria.direct_debit: a Direct Debit mandate or collection
criteria.card: a card itself (replacement, dispatch, block, restriction, PIN)
criteria.card_payment: a card purchase or card payment attempt
criteria.batch: an uploaded payment or payroll file, or a row in it
criteria.payment_package: a payment package waiting for signatories
criteria.profile: the customer's profile details (name, phone, address)
criteria.access: signing in, devices, sessions, password recovery
criteria.document: an export, a report or a bank confirmation document
criteria.fee: a fee or charge applied by the bank
criteria.role: a user's role or access in a company profile
criteria.unknown: The text does not say, or says too little to tell.

content.text:
The recurring-payments check on this account has been requested. The case is now waiting on that result, so I'm stopping here. The incoming-payments check was refused because the desk only allows one system check at a time.

Once the standing orders and Direct Debits are known, the next step is to see whether anything is still attached to the account before I decide on closure. I haven't closed the account or set up any forwarding of incoming money.
